snippet.title: Hotel Barcelona | Tokyo Game Show 2025
snippet.description:
Legendary Japanese creators SWERY (Deadly Premonition, D4: Dark Dreams Don’t Die) and SUDA51 (No More Heroes, Lollipop Chainsaw) welcome you to HOTEL BARCELONA – a surreal, blood-soaked side-scrolling roguelite launching September 26, 2025 on Xbox Series X|S.

Step into the shoes of rookie U.S. Marshal Justine, possessed by the spirit of a serial killer, as you fight through seven twisted areas of a cursed hotel. Each run throws new threats, strange guests, and brutal challenges your way.

Play solo or team up in online co-op multiplayer to survive the nightmare together. You’ll fight, die, repeat, and maybe uncover the truth behind the Seven Slasher Killers who stalk the halls. PvP invasion adds another layer of terror, letting players step into each other’s worlds as doppelgängers in deadly showdowns.

With fast, fluid combat, roguelite progression, and a love letter to classic horror of the ’80s, ’90s, and 2000s, HOTEL BARCELONA is a must-play for fans of horror games, roguelites, slashers, and Japanese action.

HOTEL BARCELONA launches September 26, 2025 on Xbox Series X|S and PC.
